newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch June-Aug unemployment seen steady.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch June-Aug unemployment seen steady.

text.p: Dutch unemployment should steady in the latest June to August period, according to five economists polled by Reuters.

They expected the data on Wednesday to show the average number of jobless people during the seasonally adjusted June to August period to be 428,000, unchanged from the May-July period and down from 434,000 in April-June.
On a non-seasonally adjusted basis, they saw the figure edging up to 423,000 in June to August from 414,000 in May-July.
The Dutch statistics office (CBS) presents unemployment statistics as rolling three-month averages, basing its figures on job centre registrations and a monthly labour force survey.
